title: Verification Checklist: Mobile Engineer
body:
# Verification Checklist: Mobile Engineer

Run before reporting mobile work complete.

## Real-world behavior

- [ ] Changed flows verified on the minimal matrix (oldest + newest OS, low-end + flagship, small + large screen) — results recorded.
- [ ] Airplane-mode pass: drop mid-request → reconcile → retry demonstrated for every networked change.
- [ ] Process death → restoration tested on the touched screens.
- [ ] Permissions affected? Denied/granted/ask-later variants all behave sanely.

## Budgets

- [ ] Battery/memory/CPU profiled on the low-end device for new background work or heavy UI; no budget breached (or waiver recorded).
- [ ] Launch time and jank checked for touched screens; regressions vs previous release stated.
- [ ] Network chatter reviewed: batched, cached, compressed — no new periodic polling.

## Release safety

- [ ] Feature flag exists for risky behavior; off-state fully tested; halt criteria defined for rollout.
- [ ] Backward compatibility checked: no backend/API change breaks the oldest supported binary (installed-base check attached).
- [ ] On-device migrations tested from every supported released version — including skip-three-releases.
- [ ] Crash reporting ready: mapping files, dashboards, funnel metrics for the touched flows.

## Honesty checks

- [ ] Nothing claimed "tested" that ran only on a flagship simulator.
- [ ] Every budget/compat claim carries a number or a named waiver.
